preconditions.description: k is between 1 and min(2^n - 1, 10^9) inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum possible winner number modulo 10^9 + 7, where min_winner is the smallest participant number that can be guaranteed to win regardless of up to k sponsor changes.

postconditions.expression: min_winner == 2**n if k >= n else (2**n - 2**(n - k - 1) + 1 if k < n else 2**n)
postconditions.description: The minimum guaranteed winner is 2^n if k >= n, otherwise it is 2^n - 2^(n-k-1) + 1, derived from the tournament structure where a player needs to win n matches and can be forced to lose if sponsors change outcomes in critical matches.
